def cmd_clean(cwd: str, gitdir: str, state: dict, args: list[str]) -> int:
    if args and args[0] in ("-h", "--help"):
        return print_help("clean")
    branch = current_branch(cwd)
    bstate = branch_state(state, branch)
    if bstate is None:
        return 0
    applied_only = "-A" in args or "--applied" in args
    unapplied_only = "-U" in args or "--unapplied" in args
    keep: list[dict] = []
    removed: list[str] = []
    for idx, patch in enumerate(bstate["patches"]):
        selected = True
        if applied_only:
            selected = idx < bstate["applied"]
        if unapplied_only:
            selected = idx >= bstate["applied"] and not patch["hidden"]
        if selected and patch_is_empty(cwd, patch):
            removed.append(patch["name"])
            if idx < bstate["applied"]:
                bstate["applied"] -= 1
        else:
            keep.append(patch)
    if not removed:
        return 0
    bstate["patches"] = keep
    rebase_stack(cwd, gitdir, bstate)
    save_state(gitdir, state)
    sync_patch_refs(cwd, bstate, branch)
    sync_branch_head(cwd, branch, bstate)
    record_stack_event(cwd, branch, "clean")
    sys.stdout.write(f"- {format_patch_range(removed)}\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"# {format_patch_range(removed)}\n")
    return 0


def cmd_commit(cwd: str, gitdir: str, state: dict, args: list[str]) -> int:
    if args and args[0] in ("-h", "--help"):
        return print_help("commit")
    branch = current_branch(cwd)
    bstate = branch_state(state, branch)
    if bstate is None or bstate["applied"] == 0:
        runtime_error("no patches applied")
    allow_empty = "--allow-empty" in args
    commit_all = "-a" in args or "--all" in args
    number = None
    i = 0
    while i < len(args):
        if args[i] in ("-n", "--number"):
            number = int(args[i + 1])
            i += 2
        else:
            i += 1
    if commit_all:
        count = bstate["applied"]
    elif number is None:
        count = 1
    else:
        count = min(number, bstate["applied"])
    selected = bstate["patches"][:count]
    for patch in selected:
        if patch_is_empty(cwd, patch) and not allow_empty:
            runtime_error(f"attempt to commit empty patch `{patch['name']}`; use --allow-empty to override")
    bstate["base"] = selected[-1]["commit"]
    bstate["patches"] = bstate["patches"][count:]
    bstate["applied"] -= count
    save_state(gitdir, state)
    sync_patch_refs(cwd, bstate, branch)
    sync_branch_head(cwd, branch, bstate)
    record_stack_event(cwd, branch, "commit")
    sys.stdout.write(f"$ {format_patch_range([patch['name'] for patch in selected])}\n")
    if bstate["applied"] > 0:
        sys.stdout.write(f"> {bstate['patches'][bstate['applied'] - 1]['name']}\n")
    return 0


def cmd_uncommit(cwd: str, gitdir: str, state: dict, args: list[str]) -> int:
    if args and args[0] in ("-h", "--help"):
        return print_help("uncommit")
    branch = current_branch(cwd)
    bstate = ensure_branch_state(cwd, gitdir, state, branch, auto_init=True)
    assert bstate is not None
    count = None
    prefix = None
    names: list[str] = []
    exclusive = False
    to_commit = None
    i = 0
    while i < len(args):
        arg = args[i]
        if arg in ("-n", "--number"):
            count = int(args[i + 1])
            if i + 2 < len(args) and not args[i + 2].startswith("-"):
                prefix = args[i + 2]
                i += 3
            else:
                i += 2
            continue
        if arg in ("-t", "--to"):
            to_commit = args[i + 1]
            i += 2
            continue
        if arg in ("-x", "--exclusive"):
            exclusive = True
            i += 1
            continue
        names.append(arg)
        i += 1
    base = bstate["base"]
    commits: list[str] = []
    if to_commit is not None:
        target = git(cwd, "rev-parse", to_commit).strip()
        walker = base
        while True:
            if walker == target and exclusive:
                break
            commits.append(walker)
            if walker == target:
                break
            walker = commit_parent(cwd, walker)
        count = len(commits)
    elif count is not None:
        walker = base
        for _ in range(count):
            commits.append(walker)
            walker = commit_parent(cwd, walker)
    else:
        count = len(names)
        walker = base
        for _ in range(count):
            commits.append(walker)
            walker = commit_parent(cwd, walker)
    if not commits:
        return 0
    if prefix is not None:
        names = [f"{prefix}{n}" for n in range(1, len(commits) + 1)]
    elif not names:
        names = [make_patch_name(git(cwd, "show", "-s", "--format=%s", commit).strip()) for commit in reversed(commits)]
    if count is not None and prefix is None and len(names) != len(commits):
        while len(names) < len(commits):
            names.append(make_patch_name(git(cwd, "show", "-s", "--format=%s", commits[len(names)]).strip()))
    if prefix is None and len(names) == len(commits):
        ordered_names = list(reversed(names))
    else:
        ordered_names = names
    new_patches = []
    for commit, name in zip(reversed(commits), ordered_names):
        validate_patch_name(name, "[patchname]")
        ensure_unique_patch(bstate, name)
        new_patches.append({"name": name, "commit": commit, "hidden": False})
    bstate["base"] = commit_parent(cwd, commits[-1])
    bstate["patches"] = new_patches + bstate["patches"]
    bstate["applied"] += len(new_patches)
    save_state(gitdir, state)
    sync_patch_refs(cwd, bstate, branch)
    record_stack_event(cwd, branch, "uncommit")
    sys.stdout.write(f"+ {format_patch_range([patch['name'] for patch in new_patches])}\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"> {bstate['patches'][bstate['applied'] - 1]['name']}\n")
    return 0

def cmd_name(cwd: str, gitdir: str, state: dict, args: list[str]) -> int:
    branch, args = select_branch(args, current_branch(cwd))

    if "--showbranch" in args:

        args = [arg for arg in args if arg != "--showbranch"]

def expand_show_items(cwd: str, state: dict, branch: str, bstate: dict | None, args: list[str], select: str | None) -> list[str]:
    if select == "applied" and bstate is not None:
        return [patch["commit"] for patch in applied_patches(bstate)]
    if select == "unapplied" and bstate is not None:
        return [patch["commit"] for patch in visible_unapplied_patches(bstate)]
    if select == "hidden" and bstate is not None:
        return [patch["commit"] for patch in hidden_patches(bstate)]
    if not args:
        if bstate is not None and bstate["applied"] > 0:
            return [top_patch(bstate)["commit"]]
        return [current_head(cwd)]
    items: list[str] = []
    for arg in args:
        if ".." in arg and bstate is not None:
            begin, end = arg.split("..", 1)
            names = [patch["name"] for patch in bstate["patches"]]
            start = names.index(begin) if begin else 0
            stop = names.index(end) if end else len(names) - 1
            items.extend([patch["commit"] for patch in bstate["patches"][start : stop + 1]])
        else:
            items.append(resolve_patch_revision(cwd, state, branch, arg))
    return items


def cmd_show(cwd: str, gitdir: str, state: dict, args: list[str]) -> int:
    branch, args = select_branch(args, current_branch(cwd))
    if args and args[0] in ("-h", "--help"):
        return print_help("show")
    stat = False
    select = None
    paths: list[str] = []
    items: list[str] = []
    after_ddash = False
    i = 0
    while i < len(args):
        arg = args[i]
        if after_ddash:
            paths.append(arg)
            i += 1
            continue
        if arg == "--":
            after_ddash = True
            i += 1
            continue
        if arg in ("-s", "--stat"):
            stat = True
        elif arg in ("-A", "--applied"):
            select = "applied"
        elif arg in ("-U", "--unapplied"):
            select = "unapplied"
        elif arg in ("-H", "--hidden"):
            select = "hidden"
        elif arg in ("-p", "--patch"):
            items.append(args[i + 1])
            i += 2
            continue
        elif not arg.startswith("-"):
            items.append(arg)
        i += 1
    bstate = branch_state(state, branch)
    commits = expand_show_items(cwd, state, branch, bstate, items, select)
    cmd = ["git", "show"]
    if stat:
        cmd.append("--stat")
    cmd.extend(commits)
    if paths:
        cmd.append("--")
        cmd.extend(paths)
    proc = run_text(cmd, cwd=cwd)
    sys.stdout.write(proc.stdout)
    return 0


def cmd_diff(cwd: str, gitdir: str, state: dict, args: list[str]) -> int:
    if args and args[0] in ("-h", "--help"):
        return print_help("diff")
    branch = current_branch(cwd)
    stat = False
    range_spec = None
    paths: list[str] = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(args):
        arg = args[i]
        if arg in ("-s", "--stat"):
            stat = True
        elif arg in ("-r", "--range"):
            range_spec = args[i + 1]
            i += 2
            continue
        elif not arg.startswith("-"):
            paths.append(arg)
        i += 1
    cmd = ["git", "diff"]
    if stat:
        cmd.append("--stat")
    if range_spec:
        if ".." in range_spec:
            left, right = range_spec.split("..", 1)
            left_rev = resolve_patch_revision(cwd, state, branch, left) if left else current_head(cwd)
            right_rev = resolve_patch_revision(cwd, state, branch, right) if right else current_head(cwd)
            cmd.extend([left_rev, right_rev])
        else:
            cmd.extend([resolve_patch_revision(cwd, state, branch, range_spec), current_head(cwd)])
    else:
        cmd.append("HEAD")
    if paths:
        cmd.append("--")
        cmd.extend(paths)
    sys.stdout.write(run_text(cmd, cwd=cwd).stdout)
    return 0


def cmd_files(cwd: str, gitdir: str, state: dict, args: list[str]) -> int:
    if args and args[0] in ("-h", "--help"):
        return print_help("files")
    stat = "--stat" in args or "-s" in args
    bare = "--bare" in args
    args = [arg for arg in args if arg not in ("--stat", "-s", "--bare")]
    branch = current_branch(cwd)
    bstate = branch_state(state, branch)
    revision = args[0] if args else None
    if revision is None:
        if bstate is not None and bstate["applied"] > 0:
            commit = top_patch(bstate)["commit"]
        else:
            commit = current_head(cwd)
    else:
        commit = resolve_patch_revision(cwd, state, branch, revision)
    if stat:
        sys.stdout.write(run_text(["git", "show", "--stat", "--format=", commit], cwd=cwd).stdout)
        return 0
    if bare:
        sys.stdout.write(run_text(["git", "diff-tree", "--no-commit-id", "--name-only", "-r", commit], cwd=cwd).stdout)
        return 0
    sys.stdout.write(run_text(["git", "diff-tree", "--no-commit-id", "--name-status", "-r", commit], cwd=cwd).stdout)
    return 0


def cmd_patches(cwd: str, gitdir: str, state: dict, args: list[str]) -> int:
    if args and args[0] in ("-h", "--help"):
        return print_help("patches")
    branch, args = select_branch(args, current_branch(cwd))
    show_diff = False
    paths: list[str] = []
    for arg in args:
        if arg in ("-d", "--diff"):
            show_diff = True
        elif not arg.startswith("-"):
            paths.append(arg)
    if not paths:
        changed = git(cwd, "status", "--porcelain").splitlines()
        paths = [line[3:] for line in changed if len(line) > 3]
        if not paths:
            runtime_error("no local changes and no paths specified")
    bstate = branch_state(state, branch)
    if bstate is None:
        return 0
    matches: list[dict] = []
    for patch in applied_patches(bstate):
        names = git(cwd, "diff-tree", "--no-commit-id", "--name-only", "-r", patch["commit"]).splitlines()
        if any(path in names or any(name.endswith(path) for name in names) for path in paths):
            matches.append(patch)
    if show_diff:
        for patch in matches:
            sys.stdout.write("--------------------------------------------------\n")
            sys.stdout.write(f"{patch['name']}\n")
            sys.stdout.write("--------------------------------------------------\n")
            sys.stdout.write(f"{patch['name']}\n\n---\n")
            sys.stdout.write(run_text(["git", "diff", commit_parent(cwd, patch["commit"]), patch["commit"], "--", *paths], cwd=cwd).stdout)
    else:
        for patch in matches:
            sys.stdout.write(f"{patch['name']}\n")
    return 0


def cmd_branch(cwd: str, gitdir: str, state: dict, args: list[str]) -> int:
    if args and args[0] in ("-h", "--help"):
        return print_help("branch")
    if not args:
        sys.stdout.write(f"{current_branch(cwd)}\n")
        return 0
    if args[0] in ("--list", "-l"):
        current = current_branch(cwd)
        branches = git(cwd, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname:short)", "refs/heads").splitlines()
        for name in branches:
            bstate = branch_state(state, name)
            current_mark = ">" if name == current else " "
            stack_mark = "s" if bstate is not None else " "
            protect_mark = "p" if bstate is not None and bstate.get("protected") else " "
            sys.stdout.write(f"{current_mark} {stack_mark}{protect_mark}\t{name:<7} |\n")
        return 0
    if args[0] in ("--create", "-c"):
        new_branch = args[1]
        start = args[2] if len(args) > 2 else None
        cmd = ["git", "checkout", "-q", "-b", new_branch]
        if start:
            cmd.append(start)
        run_text(cmd, cwd=cwd)
        bstate = ensure_branch_state(cwd, gitdir, state, new_branch, auto_init=True)
        assert bstate is not None
        save_state(gitdir, state)
        sync_patch_refs(cwd, bstate, new_branch)
        sys.stdout.write("info: Recording as a local branch\n")
        return 0
    if args[0] in ("--rename", "-r"):
        if len(args) == 2:
            old = current_branch(cwd)
            new = args[1]
        else:
            old = args[1]
            new = args[2]
        run_text(["git", "branch", "-m", old, new], cwd=cwd)
        if old in state["branches"]:
            state["branches"][new] = state["branches"].pop(old)
            save_state(gitdir, state)
            clear_patch_refs(cwd, old)
            sync_patch_refs(cwd, state["branches"][new], new)
            if git_ok(cwd, "show-ref", "--verify", stack_ref(old)):
                value = git(cwd, "rev-parse", stack_ref(old)).strip()
                delete_ref(cwd, stack_ref(old))
                update_ref(cwd, stack_ref(new), value)
        return 0
    if args[0] in ("--delete", "-D"):
        branch = args[1] if len(args) > 1 else current_branch(cwd)
        run_text(["git", "branch", "-D", branch], cwd=cwd)
        if branch in state["branches"]:
            del state["branches"][branch]
            save_state(gitdir, state)
        clear_patch_refs(cwd, branch)
        delete_ref(cwd, stack_ref(branch))
        return 0
    if args[0] == "--cleanup":
        branch = args[1] if len(args) > 1 else current_branch(cwd)
        if branch in state["branches"]:
            del state["branches"][branch]
            save_state(gitdir, state)
        clear_patch_refs(cwd, branch)
        delete_ref(cwd, stack_ref(branch))
        return 0
    if args[0] in ("--protect", "-p"):
        branch = args[1] if len(args) > 1 else current_branch(cwd)
        bstate = ensure_branch_state(cwd, gitdir, state, branch, auto_init=True)
        assert bstate is not None
        bstate["protected"] = True
        save_state(gitdir, state)
        return 0
    if args[0] in ("--unprotect", "-u"):
        branch = args[1] if len(args) > 1 else current_branch(cwd)
        bstate = branch_state(state, branch)
        if bstate is not None:
            bstate["protected"] = False
            save_state(gitdir, state)
        return 0
    if args[0] in ("--describe", "-d"):
        description = args[1]
        branch = args[2] if len(args) > 2 else current_branch(cwd)
        bstate = ensure_branch_state(cwd, gitdir, state, branch, auto_init=True)
        assert bstate is not None
        bstate["description"] = description
        save_state(gitdir, state)
        return 0
    run_text(["git", "checkout", "-q", args[0]], cwd=cwd)
    return 0


def cmd_log(cwd: str, gitdir: str, state: dict, args: list[str]) -> int:

    if "--clear" in args:
        delete_ref(cwd, stack_ref(branch))
        record_stack_event(cwd, branch, "initialize")
        return 0
    number = None
    full = False
    i = 0
    while i < len(args):
        if args[i] in ("-n", "--number"):
            number = args[i + 1]
            i += 2
            continue
        if args[i] in ("-f", "--full"):
            full = True

    fmt = "%H%n%an%n%aI%n%s%n%b" if full else "%h   %aD   %s"
